title: Sharp Polynomial Upper Bounds for Anticanonical Volumes
summary: For every positive integer $n$, we prove that there is a constant $C_n$, depending only on $n$, such that $Vol(-K_X) \leq C_n ε^{-(2^n-n-1)}$ whenever $X$ admits an $ε$-lc log Fano boundary. The exponent is optimal in every dimension at least two, even for toric Fano varieties of Picard number one. In particular, the optimal exponent for fourfolds is eleven. We also prove an anticanonical interpolation theorem with optimal exponent $2^n-1$.
